stem: What is the most likely reason the author includes the phrase “mastered the art of farming in the mountains” in paragraph 3 of the article “An Ancient Farming Method”?

options.label: A
options.text: To draw attention to the striking appearance of the terraces

options.label: B
options.text: To demonstrate how highly the Inca valued farming as a profession

options.label: C
options.text: To suggest that the Inca viewed growing food as a form of expression

options.label: D
options.text: To emphasize the skill and creativity required to perfect terrace farming
